title.en: MindForge Guard Labs — Agent Claim–Evidence Review
title.zh: MindForge Guard Labs — 智能体主张—证据审阅实验

description.en: Experimental deterministic review of synthetic AI-agent claims against events, snapshots, coverage and authorization records. Not a legal evidence checklist or formal assurance service.
description.zh: 针对合成 AI Agent 主张与工具事件、状态快照、覆盖及授权记录进行确定性审阅的实验插件；不是法律证据清单检查器或正式 assurance 服务。

description.en: Deterministic, evidence-linked review of user-declared synthetic AI-agent claims against events, snapshots, coverage and authorization records. Synthetic-only; no formal Guard admission.
description.zh: 对用户声明的合成 AI Agent 主张进行确定性证据审阅，关联事件、快照、覆盖及授权记录，输出有限判定与证据引用；仅限合成数据，不代表 Guard 正式准入。
